name: Original native annotation archive admission

on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/otzaria-native-annotation-budget-20261123]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: otzaria-original-native-archive-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  original-native-archive:
    if: github.repository == 'davidpovarsky/anytype-swift' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/codex/otzaria-native-annotation-budget-20261123' && github.run_attempt == 1
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      DEVELOPER_DIR: /Applications/Xcode_27.app/Contents/Developer
    steps:
      - name: Fix the absolute native execution deadline
        run: |
          echo "OTZARIA_NATIVE_ARCHIVE_DEADLINE=$(( $(date +%s) + 6900 ))" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Checkout the exact isolated archive source packet
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-owned-annotation-contract-20261123
      - name: Select actual ARM64 Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          architecture: arm64
      - name: Install the exact original Go toolchain
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.26.5'
          cache: false
      - name: Checkout the immutable original Heart base
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: anyproto/anytype-heart
          ref: d98420b1113536afd08cde6de9a5816f6d27ffff
          path: build/Heart-Native-Archive
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Produce four actual original exports then qualify their archive admission
        run: |
          python3 -I docs/pinkha/torah-integration/native-owned-annotation-contract-20261123/slice-a/run_native_archive.py \
            --control-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --control-head "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --execution-manifest-sha256 34c60165bc4f98530055b96d514a756515ac0270ca76f2abd876299eb62db61d \
            --job-deadline-unix "$OTZARIA_NATIVE_ARCHIVE_DEADLINE" \
            --heart build/Heart-Native-Archive \
            --work build/Heart-Native-Archive-Owned-Work \
            --evidence build/Heart-Native-Archive-Evidence
      - name: Retain actual original native specimens compiler and archive evidence including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Otzaria-Original-Native-Archive-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/Heart-Native-Archive-Evidence
          if-no-files-found: warn
          compression-level: 6
          retention-days: 14
